name: AR_RECON_SUMMARY_DETAILS
description: This table stores the extract of the data, which is required for the preparation of the summary report.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This columns is the PK of this table. This is a running sequence number derived from the database sequence.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_CODE
columns.description:
This code is populated through the lookup. The lookup codes defined for this column are:  BEGIN_BAL, NON_AR_BEGIN_BAL, TRANSACTIONS, ADJUSTMENTS, APPLIED_RECEIPT, UNAPPLIED_RECEIPT, OTHER, AR_VARIANCE, AR_END_BAL,
 NON_AR_ACTIVITY, NOT_TRFD_TO_GL, NOT_POSTED_GL, GL_VARIANCE and GL_END_BALANCE.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_ORDER
columns.description: Reconciliation items on summary report in Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition must display in a specific, fixed order requiring hard coding. This column stores a numeric sequence value that sorts the report in the specified order.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: This column is populated by source data values from Subledger Accounting or GL. The lookup codes for which values are populated are: BEGIN_BAL ( GL), NON_AR_ACTIVITY, NOT_TRFD_TO_GL, NOT_POSTED_GL, GL_VARIANCE, and GL_END_BALANCE.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: The ledger for which the data extraction is being carried out.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: The BU_ID is populated for  amounts with data source of  Receivables. These amounts are stored at BU level. For example, the Begin Balance will be stored for each BU. The lookup code values for which BU_ID is populated are: BEGIN_BAL(AR), TRANSACTIONS, ADJUSTMENTS, APPLIED_RECEIPT, UNAPPLIED_RECEIPT, OTHER and AR_VARIANCE.

columns.name: AR_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: This column is populated for the amounts that are extracted from receivables tables. The lookup code values for which the column is populated are: BEGIN_BAL(AR), TRANSACTIONS, ADJUSTMENTS, APPLIED_RECEIPT, UNAPPLIED_RECEIPT, OTHER and AR_VARIANCE.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: The debit amounts will be populated for the amounts that are being extracted for SLA or GL.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: The credit amounts will be populated for the amounts that are being extracted for SLA or GL.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: The data source will have the following values depending on the lookup code and amount which is being populated: AR, SLA, GL or Plug.

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT
columns.description: Balancing Segment

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
columns.description: Natural Account Segment

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
